name: Murali P. T.
title: Best Paper Award at International Conference on Biomechanics (ICBME 2025)
description: Recognized for pioneering research on musculoskeletal modeling and patient-specific prosthetic computational load analysis. The paper presented novel finite element formulations for knee implant bio-durability.

name: Darshana S.
title: 1st Prize — National Bio-Medical Innovation Challenge 2025
awardBody: Department of Biotechnology & IIT Madras Bio-Incubator
description: Developed a portable, low-cost microfluidic sensor for rapid point-of-care diagnosis of cardiovascular biomarkers. Awarded a seed prototyping grant of ₹2,50,000 for clinical translation.

name: Abhinav Anand
title: DAAD WISE Fellowship 2025
description: Selected for the prestigious DAAD Working Internships in Science and Engineering fellowship to conduct 3 months of summer research at TU Munich in computational fluid-structure interaction.

name: Saatvik Rao
title: Prime Minister's Research Fellowship (PMRF)
awardBody: Ministry of Education, Govt. of India
description: Awarded the prestigious PMRF grant for high-impact doctoral research on deep learning-driven ultrasound tomography and real-time tissue elasticity mapping.

name: Anuva Sen
title: Winner — Global Healthcare Hackathon 2025
awardBody: MIT Hacking Medicine & Healthcare Innovation Hub
description: Led an interdisciplinary team to design an AI-guided wearable EEG headband for automated early detection of nocturnal epileptic episodes with real-time caregiver alerts.

name: Rishi S. Kumar
title: Institute Silver Medal for Academic Excellence
description: Secured top academic rank across the department for consecutive academic terms with exceptional distinction in Solid Mechanics, Continuum Mechanics, and Biotransport.

name: Karthikeya V.
title: Inter-IIT Sports Meet Gold Medal — Badminton Men's Singles
description: Represented IIT Madras and clinched the Gold Medal in Men's Singles at the 57th Inter-IIT Sports Meet, demonstrating stellar athletic performance alongside rigorous academics.

name: Swathi Narayanan
title: Outstanding Young Researcher Award — Asian Biomaterials Congress
description: Honored with the Outstanding Young Researcher Award for work on injectable hydrogels for cartilage regeneration and drug eluting nanofibrous scaffolds.
